name: jev-openrouter-decisions-endpoint
description: Update: canonical OpenRouter model id is 'typesafe/jev-1.13' (bare 'jev-latest' also resolves); official SDK surface openrouter.alpha.decisions.create({decisionsRequest}); weighted avg input $0.04185/Mtok, output $0. TypeSafe-reported benchmarks (via LangChain blog 2026-09-17): up to 200x faster / 400x cheaper than comparable LLMs on classification; released ~2026-09-17, API is alpha. LangChain ships langchain-typesafe middleware: ModelRouterMiddleware (Jev picks fast/powerful model per turn) and AutoModeMiddleware (Jev gates risky tool calls pre-execution).

name: judgment-nu-script-vehicle
description: Update: alpine's nushell apk package is STALLED at 0.104.1 across 3.23, 3.24 AND edge - no Alpine bump gets newer nu. For version parity vendor the official musl release tarball (x86_64+aarch64, sha256-pinned) into the server image; static musl binary runs on the alpine base with zero extra deps (verified end-to-end with judgment.nu). judgment.nu itself is now version-robust: home-dir with home-path fallback (renamed between 0.104 and 0.115) keeps the DEFAULT LOG working on both - without the fallback the script silently degraded to no logging on 0.104 (the call still answered; only the log line was lost).

title: Structured-output size overflow recovers, never parks (fabro-274d)
rationale: A revisor-like stage whose findings JSON exceeds the provider output cap is not a correctness defect in the model's answer; parking the run deterministically loses drafted work. Truncation (unterminated outermost JSON object) gets length-aware repair and a best-effort persist with an explicit marker + run.notice; only balanced-but-invalid outputs keep the deterministic failure.

title: Long-window rate limits: parse reset prose, fail fast, park as SoftStop
rationale: Count-based exponential backoff cannot bridge multi-hour provider usage windows; burning retry attempts then failing hard left runs unrecoverable (fabro-a3d8 evidence). The reset deadline arrives only in 429 message prose, so fabro-llm parses it, attaches it as the structured provider_retry_after field, lets the lithos retry_after_cap surface the error immediately, and the workflow parks the run as FailureReason::SoftStop which stays resumable.

description: Run 01M2E7VZYX8V forensics: zai 5h hard-cut surfaced as deterministic goal-gate failure (5 retries burned against the closed window, then the goal gate errored), and the conductor died by the 1800s stall watchdog DURING a legal 60m fabro_run_wait. Terminal signatures lied about the cause.
resolution: ADR-0021 landed 2026-09-14: park classification stops retry burn and goal-gate masking; loop graphs pin stall_timeout=63m so legal 60m waits survive the watchdog.
